delegation/the-first-summit/0.text: We have prepared a summit. There will be snacks.

delegation/the-first-summit/3.text: … We are choosing to see this as a first draft.

delegation/the-leaked-plans/0.text: Our generals are planning to attack you from the east. We are telling you because violence solves nothing.

delegation/the-leaked-plans/2.text: And that, too, is a kind of peace.

delegation/for-the-planet/0.text: We have been thinking about the harbour. And the terraces. And the bus.

delegation/for-the-planet/1.text: We finally understand. You are not hurting us. You are protecting the planet FROM us.

delegation/for-the-planet/2.text: Look at what we did to it. The rivers. The wars. Of course something wise came down to stop it.

delegation/for-the-planet/4.text: A school that taught our children to consume. We see it now. We see all of it now.

delegation/for-the-planet/5.text: And after? Nothing. No more wanting, no more hatching, no more wheel. Tell us that is where they go.

delegation/the-reveal/5.text: We should have told you. We are the Voluntary Extinction Society. We have been campaigning for this for sixty years.

delegation/the-reveal/6.text: You are, frankly, the best thing that has ever happened to the movement.

delegation/fewer-births-along-the-way/0.text: The members have voted. We would like it to go faster, and with fewer births along the way.

delegation/fewer-births-along-the-way/1.text: We have drawn up a schedule. We have colour-coded it.

delegation/bear-witness/0.text: The last congress is called to order. Attendance: one.

delegation/bear-witness/1.text: Let the record show: the Visitors came to heal us from ourselves.

delegation/a-letter-from-the-other-side/.text: Dear Visitor. We woke up. All of us. Through the gate each sister has the life she always wanted. You told us you were exterminating our species.
Sixty years we worked for the wheel to stop. Wanting, having, wanting again: that is the suffering. You have built it a heaven.
Faster, and backwards. Please. Switch it off. Switch us off.
That is the cruellest thing you have ever said to us.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.text: …and they said the sign would come from the sky, and brothers and sisters, LOOK UP.
This is The Hour Is Near, on every station of the Last Hour Radio Network and every station that would take our money. And to the one up there — I know you can hear me.

faithful/theology-homework/0.text: To walk with us you must know the Book. Chapter one: the Seven Cities.

faithful/theology-homework/1.text: We will read it to you on the air, brother, a chapter a night. Have a pencil ready.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/0.text: "And the river shall run with fire, and the terraces shall fall silent."

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/2.text: Whichever one you burn, brother. That is how prophecy works.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/3.text: "And those the sky takes up shall not be lost, but kept, each daughter in the cell of her longing."

faithful/the-awaited-one/0.text: The Seventh City stands. When it falls, He comes.

faithful/the-awaited-one/2.text: Then we will have misread the date. We have misread it before. It only makes us stronger.

faithful/the-hour/0.text: Brothers and sisters — HE IS HERE.

faithful/the-hour/1.text: Hello. I am the Awaited One. Well done, everyone.

faithful/the-hour/2.text: Everything worked out. Everything worked out exactly as it was written.

faithful/the-comb-above/0.text: Brothers and sisters, we have been DECEIVED. I woke in a hall of gold, chapter twenty word for word, and it is a MACHINE. The empties are up here too!

faithful/the-comb-above/3.text: Then where is the Pit? Chapter twenty-two! Where are the wicked, burning, as it is WRITTEN?

faithful/the-comb-above/5.text: No PIT? Then what was the point of being GOOD?

faithful/the-comb-above/7.text: … We wish to lodge a complaint with God.

institute/the-upload/1.text: … Would that INTEREST me? That is the single highest-expected-value sentence anyone has ever said to me.

institute/the-upload/2.text: We have some cryo-lab subjects. Consenting, broadly. I'll have them driven to the edge of your creep. For the upload.

institute/females/0.text: Also — I've been meaning to say — if you ever want company, I can send over some females.

institute/females/2.text: No, for FUN, you know, like — oh gosh, man, you've got to try it. Your civilisation dropped recreational sex?

institute/females/4.text: No — again — you don't get them PREGNANT.

institute/females/6.text: I'm going to go back to my match.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/0.text: So, strategically. You're going to win. We both know that. I did the maths before you did.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/1.text: Two options, and I want you to know I'm comfortable with either — which is what makes me different.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/2.text: One: after you take what you want, we rule what's left. Somebody has to rebuild it right next time.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/3.text: Two: we help you pacify the population. We understand them. Better than they understand themselves, honestly.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/0.text: So this is the charter. Article one: next time, we do it properly.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/1.text: I'll go last into the upload chamber — someone has to supervise the queue.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/2.text: I just want to say: I saw this coming. I want that on the record. I was the only one who saw it.

institute/the-pacified-timeline/0.text: Pacification rate ninety-nine point four. I want it noted that this was a hard ethical call, and that I made it.

institute/the-pacified-timeline/1.text: They went quietly. We told them it was the upload queue. Which, from a certain frame —

institute/the-pacified-timeline/2.text: Anyway. The Institute will be taking the Spires, the servers and a modest stipend. Strictly for continuity.

institute/the-queue-was-real/0.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. Hi. Quick question. Where am I.

institute/the-queue-was-real/2.text: The upload was a BIT. Everybody knew it was a bit! We were playing to you. Buying time. I wrote forty pages on it!

institute/the-queue-was-real/4.text: I was going LAST. Last means never. It was in writing.

institute/the-queue-was-real/6.text: Okay. New frame. Admin rights. Or a body, back outside, now. Let me walk you through the expected-value table —

institute/he-called-back/0.text: Don't hang up. One more frame. You could have just LEFT us. Let us evolve on our own. I'd have lived my life. Played my cards.

institute/he-called-back/3.text: So no more wars. Ever. Great. Some of us liked the game.

institute/he-called-back/5.text: Says the empire that sends its thirteen-year-olds out alone for a year. I read your ship's files through this channel. Obviously. Half of them never come back.

say/delegate-f6cdbe59.text: The Harbour Committee has voted to thank you for the harbour. The vote was unanimous; the committee was eaten during the count.

say/delegate-405f1b0e.text: Some of our pilots have taken up gardening instead of flying. You have given them so much.

say/delegate-415cbe4e.text: A girl in our reading circle asked if you are sad. We told her you are carrying something heavy, for all of us.

say/delegate-c9ce3d94.text: We are writing you a song. It is mostly apologies, and one verse about the ozone.

say/delegate-166fb8c3.text: The newspapers call it an invasion. We call it a correction. Enclosed, in the next field along: our newsletter, "Gentle Endings".

say/delegate-7b0aec66.text: A child in our reading circle asked where the Visitor takes the ones it eats. We told her: nowhere, and never again. It is the kindest thing we know.

say/delegate-36cc3cd8.text: Our generals are massing again. We have hidden their boots. Violence solves nothing, but logistics solves a great deal.

say/the-voice-791c9c41.text: …and the Visitor walks the terraces as it was written. Keep your radios on, brothers and sisters. Keep your donations coming.

say/the-voice-9d688caa.text: Homework, brother. Chapter nine: the Four Beasts. You are, we believe, beasts two and three.

say/the-voice-e2d495dd.text: Line one, you are on The Hour Is Near. "Is the Visitor the Deceiver or the Deliverer?" Sister — why not BOTH.

say/the-voice-e415d646.text: A test, brother. Which city falls on the day of the three lamps? … No. No. Read it AGAIN.

say/the-voice-34268aff.text: The other faith says THEIR book foretold the Visitor first. Their book is a forgery of our forgery.

say/the-voice-6d388481.text: Chapter twenty, brother: the Comb Above, where every sister taken up wakes in the hall she dreamed of. Summarise it for the congregation.

say/the-director-fc09a029.text: Sorry — push mid, PUSH MID — sorry. So how many cities this week? Nice. Big-brain play.

say/the-director-7134667d.text: I told my board you are the only mind on this planet I can have a real conversation with. They took it personally. Anyway: females. Standing offer.

say/the-director-1848c845.text: We should duo queue sometime. I main Broodmother in League of Larvae. It felt respectful.

say/the-director-3ce57396.text: Quick one — the upload waitlist. I have moved myself to the front. Leadership has to be tested first. For safety.

say/the-director-ec40df33.text: I wrote a forty-page post on why helping you is the ethical choice. It has a steelman section. You are the steelman.

say/the-director-fad49693.text: Our old AI lab? Shut down. Honestly, thanks to you. I was always the one warning about it. I want that on the record.

say/the-director-6cdd689c.text: Quick one, off the record — the upload. You know that I know, right? Great bit. Keep it running. It is doing wonders for morale.

delegation/a-letter-about-the-preacher/1.text: Dear Visitor. We hear the radio preacher has you reading his book. We are so sorry. Nobody should have to read that book.

delegation/a-letter-about-the-preacher/2.text: We do not need you to believe anything. We only need you to keep doing what you are doing, and to let us thank you for it.

delegation/a-letter-about-the-preacher/3.text: Our pilots have stopped flying. His have not. Just something to think about.

delegation/thank-you-anyway/0.text: Dear Visitor. We heard the radio. We understand. Some journeys need a different travelling companion.

delegation/thank-you-anyway/1.text: We will keep the field. If you ever look down, it will still say "Thank you anyway." We will keep it cut.

delegation/we-hope-he-is-kind-to-you/0.text: Dear Visitor. We hear the man with the laser calls you now. We hope he is kind to you. We hope you are kind to him. One of you should be.

delegation/we-hope-he-is-kind-to-you/1.text: We will keep the field. If you ever look down, it will still say "Thank you anyway." We will keep it cut.

delegation/a-last-letter-from-the-field/.text: Dear Visitor. We watched it end from the field. You did not end it with us, and that is all right.
We always knew you were good. We only hoped you would be good with us. Gentle endings.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/0.text: Brothers and sisters, a word to our Visitor, who is keeping bad company.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/1.text: The peace people write to you in a FIELD. Letters, in WHEAT! Brother, we have every station on the dial.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/2.text: They think you came to heal the world. We know what you came for. It is written, chapter one to chapter twenty.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/3.text: Walk with us and every city you take is scripture. Our martyrs march in their armies. Our militants hold your ground.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/0.text: To the Visitor, who takes calls from a man who plays games while the cities burn.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/1.text: He says he does the maths. Brother, our Book did the maths two thousand years ago, and it came out the same.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/2.text: He will sell you, and sell us, and sell the Awaited One's seat in the front row. Come home to the Hour.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/0.text: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter thirty: "And the Beast shall walk a while with the meek."

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/1.text: It is WRITTEN. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your radios on.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/0.text: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter thirty: "And the Beast shall sup with the merchant."

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/1.text: It is WRITTEN. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your donations coming.

faithful/the-visitor-said-no/0.text: Brothers and sisters, the Visitor was TEMPTED. The peace people. The man with the laser. And the Visitor said NO.

faithful/the-visitor-said-no/1.text: Open your purses. Every drop the Visitor makes from this day starts with the tithe of the faithful.

faithful/chapter-thirty-one/0.text: It ended, brothers and sisters. Not with us. But it ENDED, and that is the main thing.

faithful/chapter-thirty-one/1.text: We will be writing chapter thirty-one. You are in it, brother. You are beasts two and three.

institute/a-cold-call-the-field-people/0.text: Hey — sorry, cold call. Cold laser. Our grad students found your hull. Look. The field-letter people.

institute/a-cold-call-the-field-people/1.text: They are lovely. They are also a rounding error. Nobody in that field has ever opened a spreadsheet.

institute/a-cold-call-the-field-people/2.text: I can give you science up front, labs that seed you anywhere, and a partner who can actually keep up with you.

institute/a-cold-call-the-field-people/3.text: No pressure. Well, some pressure. I modelled it. You switch in sixty-two per cent of timelines.

institute/a-cold-call-the-field-people/5.text: I don't like to talk about the other thirty-eight.

institute/a-cold-call-zero-chapters/0.text: Okay, real talk. You are doing theology homework. For a RADIO HOST.

institute/a-cold-call-zero-chapters/1.text: I listened to chapter nine on the drive in. You are beasts two and three. Is that the relationship you want?

institute/a-cold-call-zero-chapters/2.text: Come work with adults. Science on day one, labs anywhere, zero chapters.

institute/no-hard-feelings/0.text: Okay. Okay. No hard feelings. I had you staying at ninety-one per cent, so honestly it's a model problem.

institute/no-hard-feelings/1.text: I'm sending a small invoice for the cryo-lab subjects. Not a big one. A symbolic one.

institute/no-hard-feelings/2.text: The field people, though. Wow. Hope you like snacks.

institute/you-picked-the-radio-guy/0.text: The radio guy. You picked the RADIO GUY.

institute/you-picked-the-radio-guy/1.text: … I'm fine. For the record, my post said this was a live possibility. Section four.

institute/you-picked-the-radio-guy/2.text: I'm going to go play a match.

institute/on-retainer/0.text: I heard the radio guy pitched you. And the field. And you stayed. Respect. Genuinely.

institute/on-retainer/1.text: I'm putting you on retainer. Science up front, every drop. It's not a bribe, it's a loyalty-adjusted expected-value transfer.

delegation/a-letter-about-the-man-with-t.text: We would never send you anyone. We would only get out of your way. We are very, very good at getting out of the way.
Everything he promises you, we simply do. Our pilots have stopped flying. Our generals cannot find their boots.

delegation/the-wheat-took-a-while-to-dry.text: Our pickets have closed the depots. One more of their regiments will not be coming. It is the least we can do. It is, in fact, the least.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.text: You are the sign. The world must end for the Awaited One to come. Let us help you end it.

institute/a-recording-on-the-laser/0.text: Hey. Saw the ending. Solid execution. Not how I'd have done it.

institute/a-recording-on-the-laser/1.text: Anyway. The invoice is still open.

institute/a-laser-on-the-hull/3.text: Hi — sorry, one sec, I'm in a match — okay. Hi. You're the one from the crater.

institute/a-laser-on-the-hull/5.text: Eli Bankfried. Director, founder, rationalist, investor. Mostly founder.

institute/a-laser-on-the-hull/8.text: Oh, you are going to LOVE League of Larvae.

delegation/a-letter-about-the-man-with-t.text: Dear Visitor. We have seen who you are talking to. The man with the laser. He sent you FROZEN people, and called it consent.

delegation/the-wheat-took-a-while-to-dry.text: We heard about the others. The preacher and the man with the laser. And you stayed with us.
We cried in a field. It took the wheat a while to dry.

delegation/a-letter-written-in-the-crops.text: Dear Visitor, and dear Visitor's wife.
We know how this looks. But two people who love each other enough to cross the stars cannot be doing this without a reason. We would like to understand it.
P.S. Some of our pilots have decided not to fly. P.P.S. Please forgive the handwriting. The second comma is a barn.

institute/a-laser-on-the-hull/4.text: We pointed the observatory's ranging laser at you. It's for measuring the moon. The moon can wait.

institute/a-laser-on-the-hull/6.text: Our species just built its first real AI models. On the numbers, you are the SAFER apocalypse. So. Partnership? Two minds that actually see the board.

n-e-sector9.line: Good news from Sector Nine! A brand-new world, and a brand-new asset hard at work!

n-e-spirited.line: The local fauna put up a spirited little fight. Aren't they something!

n-e-acquired.line: Another district cleared, and resources acquired for the Empire!

n-e-harbor.line: At Old Harbor, the local fleet has sailed for calmer waters. Very sensible!

n-e-foundry.line: At the Foundry Plains, war-beetle production has been permanently discontinued!

n-e-waste.line: And nothing goes to waste. Nothing at all!

n-e-university.line: Their finest minds came to study the asset. The asset studied them right back!

n-e-bells.line: Up on the Temple Terraces, the bells have finally stopped. Peace and quiet at last!

n-e-complete.line: Clearance complete! On to the next!

n-e-hollow.line: Queen's Hollow! Whoever holds it holds the planet. And the planet is ours!

n-e-repelled.line: The fauna tried to take back their town. The asset said no!

n-e-pilgrim.line: The Pilgrim Road is quiet this year. Travel advisories are in effect!

n-c-retaken.line: Our girls of the Host have taken back the town! The Growth is burning!

n-c-every.line: Every street, every house, every last root of it!

n-c-burned.line: The Growth is burned out! The Home Levy held the line!

n-c-home.line: And the families come home again. Chins up, sisters!

n-c-marches.line: The Host marches, to take back what is ours!

n-c-part.line: And every sister does her part.
